metadata.description: Azure region. Defaults to the resource group location.
Name of the Container App (and the prefix for its managed identity).
Resource id of an existing Container Apps managed environment to host the app.
Container image reference, e.g. myregistry.azurecr.io/sqlflow-control-plane:latest
Name of an existing Key Vault holding the catalog connection and JWT signing key secrets.
Key Vault secret name for the catalog ADO.NET connection string.
Key Vault secret name for the JWT signing key (must decode to at least 32 bytes).
JWT issuer the control plane validates.
JWT audience the control plane validates.
Run the in-process worker inside the control plane (single-app mode). Set false when dedicated workers (worker.bicep) drain the run queue, so API replicas do API work only.
Browser origins allowed to call the API, e.g. the gui.bicep app URL. Leave empty when the GUI is same-origin behind a path-splitting front, or when only non-browser clients call the API.
Key Vault secret name for the initial admin password (at least 12 characters). When set, bootstrap provisioning creates that admin on first start; leave empty to skip user bootstrap.
Username for the bootstrap admin. Only used when bootstrapAdminPasswordSecretName is set.
Key Vault secret name for a git token used by managed sync to fetch private remotes. Leave empty when every registered repo is public.

Username paired with the git token when the host requires one (Bitbucket app passwords take the account username, repository access tokens take x-token-auth; GitHub ignores it). Empty sends the token alone.
CIDRs of the ingress hops to trust for X-Forwarded-* headers. Leave empty to keep proxy trust off; per-client rate limiting then keys on the ingress hop address instead of the real client.

Name of a container registry in THIS resource group: the template grants the app identity AcrPull on it and configures the pull. Leave empty for a public registry, or one you authorize yourself via acrLoginServer.
Login server of a registry outside this resource group (grant AcrPull to the app identity yourself). Ignored when acrName is set.
Minimum replicas. Keep at 1 so the API is warm (a trigger never waits on a cold start).
Maximum replicas for ingress autoscale.

variables.bootstrapSecrets: [if(empty(parameters('bootstrapAdminPasswordSecretName')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'bootstrap-admin-password', 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}secrets/{1}', variables('vaultUri'), parameters('bootstrapAdminPasswordSecretName')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))))))]
variables.gitTokenSecrets: [if(empty(parameters('gitTokenSecretName')), createArray(), createArray(createObject('name', 'git-token', 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}secrets/{1}', variables('vaultUri'), parameters('gitTokenSecretName')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))))))]

resources.name: [parameters('name')]

configuration.registries: [if(empty(if(not(empty(parameters('acrName'))), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), '2023-07-01').loginServer, parameters('acrLoginServer'))), createArray(), createArray(createObject('server', if(not(empty(parameters('acrName'))), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), '2023-07-01').loginServer, parameters('acrLoginServer')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))))))]

containers.name: control-plane
containers.env: [concat(createArray(createObject('name', 'SQLFLOW_CATALOG_DB', 'secretRef', 'catalog-db'), createObject('name', 'SQLFLOW_AZURE_AUTH', 'value', 'mi'), createObject('name', 'AZURE_CLIENT_ID', 'value', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))), '2023-01-31').clientId), createObject('name', 'ControlPlane__Jwt__SigningKey', 'secretRef', 'jwt-signing-key'), createObject('name', 'ControlPlane__Jwt__Issuer', 'value', parameters('jwtIssuer')), createObject('name', 'ControlPlane__Jwt__Audience', 'value', parameters('jwtAudience')), createObject('name', 'ControlPlane__Worker__Enabled', 'value', if(parameters('workerEnabled'), 'true', 'false'))), variables('bootstrapEnv'), variables('gitTokenEnv'), variables('gitUsernameEnv'), variables('corsEnv'), variables('proxyEnv'))]

dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceGroup().id, parameters('acrName'), resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))), variables('acrPullRoleId')))]

metadata.description: The control plane base URL to give the ADF pipeline as controlPlaneBaseUrl.
The client id of the app identity (grant it db_datareader/writer on the catalog + access to flow secrets).
The principal (object) id of the app identity, for role assignments made outside this template.
